children: Chinese government bond prices have risen this year, pulling down the yield on China's benchmark 10-year bond on Wednesday to as low as 1.7%. That is more than 3 percentage points below the 5.3% yield on the equivalent U.S. Treasury note. It is also well below the yields on benchmark 10-year bonds from the U.K., France and Japan.
"China is bucking the entire global trend," said Lynn Song, chief economist for China at investment bank ING.
